title: Grateful Dead Live at Feyline Field on 1973-11-25

ai_review.summary: Superb soundboard capture of a tight 1973 show highlighted by a smoking China > Rider and an epic Eyes‑of‑the‑World/Weather Report Suite sequence.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑sourced soundboard is crystal‑clear with only minor early SQ quirks, making the performance a joy to hear. The band is razor‑tight from the second set onward, delivering standout moments like China > Rider, the Eyes of the World → Weather Report Suite → Let It Grow medley, and an energetic We Bid You Goodnight featuring Donna Jean. While the opening three numbers feel like warm‑up, the rest of the concert is consistently high‑energy and musically rich.

ai_rating.rationale: Average rating across 16 reviews is ~4.75; comments are uniformly enthusiastic about both the music and the sound quality, with only minor technical complaints.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Exceptionally clear Miller transfer with pristine balance; a few early SQ issues on "Promised Land" and minor digital glitches on "Sugaree," but overall the sound is superb.

standout_songs: Eyes of the World > Weather Report Suite > Let It Grow
Row Jimmy (noted as a solid performance)
poor_songs: Early warm‑up trio (first three songs: Don't Ease, Black-Throat, T.Jed) considered sluggish
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set warms up before taking off with strong classics; second set erupts with high‑energy jams and seamless segues, ending on an uplifting encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: In perfect command with creative wah‑wah tones; described as "master of the guild" during the China>Rider and Eyes/Weather Report sections.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass work praised as superb, especially on the Eyes of the World segment where he locks in tightly with the groove.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals strong overall though a reviewer notes occasional over‑zealousness early; Donna Jean’s voice shines on the final Goodnight.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's organ tone noted as perfect on the Weather Report Suite, adding depth to the medley.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy (Bill) praised for setting tempo and driving the energy throughout the show.
